## Length (Substack / email)

**Authoritative ceiling (email, not Substack’s own word cap):** Substack states there is **no** word-count or length restriction on posts, but the editor can show **“Post too long for email”** when the **email** may be **clipped or truncated** in some inboxes—specifically citing **Gmail** truncating messages **over 102KB** (**serialized message size** in the inbox: HTML, images, embeds, tracking—not raw Markdown word count). You can still publish; readers may need **“View entire message.”** There is **no** reliable standalone **“Gmail word limit”**; clipping risk tracks **rendered email bytes**.
